thread:
maya: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from the runtime section of the all-hands. A few folks asked for concrete timelines on kernel parity and when batching changes hit Dedicated. Can we capture next steps here?

sanjay: Short answers: kernel parity for the critical ops is targeted EOW (end of week) for the v2 path; broader kernel merge for other ops by next sprint. Dedicated rollout: small canary next Wed, then 2-week ramp if metrics look good.

ellie: To add: v2 path covers fused attention + rematerialized MLP kernels. We'll land tests today but still validating long-sequence tailcases.

joel: For Dedicated canary, need a config change on the autoscaler — set `batch_size_target: 48` and enable `kv_cache_sharing: true` on the canary pool. I'll post the snippet later.

priya: From product: we need a short blurb for customers on behavior changes (latency improvements + potential small regen variance). I'll draft and share.

maya: @ellie can you confirm which specific logs we should watch during the canary? latency p50/p95 + mem OOMs?

ellie: yes — watch p50/p95, token throughput, and an increase in `kv_miss_ratio`. Also watch the `kernel_fallback_rate` metric (if >1% we pause).

joel: snippet for autoscaler canary:
```
pool: canary-a
batch_size_target: 48
kv_cache_sharing: true
fallback_policy: "model-variant"
```
I'll push to the canary repo after approvals.

deploy-bot: deploy started for canary-a at commit b2f4c1 — ETA 12m.

maya: Thanks — last ask: owners for the incident runbook updates? (we want to include kernel fallback playbook).

sanjay: assign to @ellie (runtime) and @joel (infra) to co-own, and @priya to own customer comms.

ellie: I’ll update the runbook today and add a short checklist.

priya: I'll draft the customer note and post to #marketing for review.

maya: Perfect. If anyone sees regressions, call it out in this thread and tag me. :thumbsup:

joel: canary deployed, verifying metrics now.

deploy-bot: canary-a: healthy. No OOMs in first 30m.

maya: Great, closing loop — we'll reconvene if any regressions show up.
